India vs Sri Lanka Cricket Test: India All Out for 462, Takes Lead

In the first Test match between India and Sri Lanka, India was bowled out for 462 runs on the third day. Devdutt Padikkal was a key scorer, making 167 runs. Spinners Manav Suthar and Ravindra Jadeja were instrumental in restricting Sri Lanka, with Suthar taking eight wickets and contributing to Sri Lanka's struggle at home. India extended their lead to 294 runs by lunch on Day 4, reaching 116-4. Sri Lanka had slipped to 99/5 by lunch on Day 3.
